objects.description: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) used the [PowerExchange](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1173) utility and other tools to create tunnels to C2 servers.(Citation: FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017)
